children: DocGo agreed to sell its CIED monitoring business for $20M cash at closing, subject to customary adjustments, plus up to $5M in earnouts over two years. The deal is expected to close by the end of 2026, subject to customary conditions.
Sale consideration: $20M cash plus up to $5M earnout
The cash proceeds are subject to customary purchase price adjustments; the additional amount depends on performance.
DocGo retains 67% of the sale proceeds
Proceeds attributable to DocGo reflect its ownership stake in Cardiac RMS.
Deal expected to close by end of 2026
Closing remains subject to customary conditions, so proceeds are not immediate.
DocGo retains key Virtual Care Management services
The transaction excludes these capabilities, which DocGo plans to combine with Hicuity Health's remote patient monitoring offering.

This is a strategic asset sale following DocGo's strategic alternatives review, with the company describing the CIED business as non-core. The next catalyst is closing by the end of 2026 and disclosure of final proceeds after adjustments and any earnout performance.
